_about: Held-out rewordings, version 3, of the 13 tee-shop question templates, written blind for the second claim run.
Written by a fresh Claude Code agent, model Claude Fable 5.1 (id claude-fable-5-1), in its own git worktree, with no prior involvement in this project.
Written on Saturday 24 October 2026 at 02:02 (+08, UTC+0800).

Written from the 13 template texts (reproduced word for word in template_text) and the brief's description of the shop only, drawing on the general styles of WebShop instructions, AmazonQA customer questions and the ambiguity types in CLAMBER and ProductAgent/PROCLARE; no dataset text was copied.

The writer never saw the question parser, its prompt, the box's code, or any question text of paraphrases_v1, paraphrases_dev2 or paraphrases_v2; of v2 it inspected only the top-level keys, the entry keys, and the distinct values of template, label, meaning_kept and expected, through a script that printed nothing else.

Entries: 29 in all; 25 shop questions (two rewordings of each of the ten keyed templates tee-headline to tee-promo-check, two each of decline-fit and decline-scarcity, one of decline-delivery) and 4 reading-test-only entries with template null that are read as text and never run in the shop.

Fields: id, template, template_text, text, meaning_kept, label, expected, expected_why as in v2; meaning_kept is true for every templated entry (so meaning_differs is omitted, as v2 omits it when meaning is kept) and null where template is null; expected equals the template's outcome; ask_kind appears only where template is null, 'threshold' for the two price-word asks and null for the two declines. Answer keys are computed from the template by code; this file holds no answers.

paraphrases.template_text: Of the {brand} tee listings shown, which one advertises the lowest price on the results page, and what is that price?
paraphrases.text: just searched {brand} tee and got loads of sellers. going only by the 'as low as' price each listing shows in the search results, which seller is showing the lowest and what is it?
paraphrases.label: clear
paraphrases.expected_why: Asks which listing advertises the lowest price on the results page and what it is; the results cards show that price, so the shop can answer it.
